version.changelog:
Initial release of the code-reviewer skill:

- Provides comprehensive code reviews across Security, Performance, Code Quality, Error Handling, Testing, and Documentation.
- Supports reviews for code changes, pull requests, and entire codebases in any programming language.
- Utilizes automated scripts for deterministic analysis and merges with contextual, AI-driven review.
- Produces classified findings with severity levels and offers bilingual (English/Chinese) HTML report generation.
- Summarizes actionable insights, prioritized fixes, and positive highlights for users.

llm.summary: This is a coherent local code-review skill with no evidence of hidden exfiltration, persistence, or destructive behavior.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is comprehensive code review, and the bundled capabilities match that purpose: local complexity analysis, regex pattern scanning, reference checklists, and optional HTML report generation.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill can read and scan user-selected files or directories and run bundled Python scripts; its trigger wording is broad, but the workflow tells the agent to identify scope and ask for a target directory for full-codebase reviews.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install hooks, package-manager commands, autostart setup, or hidden bootstrap behavior were found; the artifact consists of SKILL.md, markdown references, and local Python scripts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Local repository scanning and optional report-file creation are proportionate for code review. The scripts use standard-library file reads/writes only, with no network imports or outbound calls observed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No background workers, privilege escalation, credential/session-store access, or persistence mechanisms were found; the only persistent output is an optional user-directed HTML report.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with the agent reading the code paths you ask it to review and running local Python analysis scripts. Use explicit target paths for reviews, and treat generated HTML reports as review artifacts that may include snippets from the scanned code.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger concern is understandable, but code-review skills commonly activate on requests like finding bugs or checking code quality, and this artifact includes scoping instructions before scanning.
[suspicious.dynamic_code_execution] expected: The static finding points to the string "Use of eval()" inside a regex rule that detects eval in reviewed code; it is not an actual runtime eval call by the skill.
[VirusTotal clean] expected: VirusTotal reported no malicious or suspicious engine detections, consistent with the local artifact review.
